endorsements.name: Rayhan Ahmed Niloy
endorsements.label: CVE-2021-21434
endorsements.description: Survey administrator can craft a survey in such way that malicious code can be executed in the agent interface (i.e. another agent who wants to make changes in the survey). This issue affects: OTRS AG Survey 6.0.x version 6.0.20 and prior versions; 7.0.x version 7.0.19 and prior versions.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: LOW (CVSS 3.1, 3.5)

povs.explanation: A published CVE record provides public, independently verifiable recognition of the credited vulnerability disclosure.

endorsements.name: Rayhan Ahmed Niloy
endorsements.label: CVE-2022-25967
endorsements.description: Versions of the package eta before 2.0.0 are vulnerable to Remote Code Execution (RCE) by overwriting template engine configuration variables with view options received from The Express render API.**Note:** This is exploitable only for users who are rendering templates with user-defined data.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 8.1)
